About Wildkale.com, Inc.:
Wildkale.com, Inc., a certified women-owned small business (MWBE) in New York City and New York State, is dedicated to promoting local and minimally processed foods. By partnering directly with New York State farmers, Wildkale develops tailored product lines for state institutions, schools and food banks, ensuring that at least 51% of the ingredients in these products are raw and minimally processed, sourced directly from local farms.
We also offer a range of plant-based products.

Institutional Expertise:
Wildkale's private label products prioritize locally sourced ingredients, receiving certification from the NYSDAM for its commitment to local sourcing. The company has become a reliable supplier for various institutional clients, including the Department of Education NYC, the Administration for Children's Services in NYC, and several schools and correctional facilities within New York State and its neighbors. Since January 2024, our product range has expanded to include a zucchini carrot loaf for the New York City Department of Education.
We also provide frozen lunch entrees to about 20 different New York State schools. Furthermore, we supply numerous food banks, including Feedmore, and Foodlin with frozen lunch meals that contain at least 51% raw agricultural products from  New  York  State  (see our  full  product  line at wildkale.com or wildkale.market).
Our extensive experience in the wholesale distribution of locally sourced ingredients from farms makes us a unique in a market where NYS and NYC prioritize local agriculture and local spending. We have a thorough understanding of institutional buying systems, emphasizing the importance of balancing cost and quality. Our direct partnerships with New York State farmers and our expertise in navigating cost-sensitive procurement systems to deliver high-quality, locally sourced products differentiate Wildkale.com from its competitors.

rows.business_description:
ArchForKids Mission: Through engaging learning programs, ArchForKids spurs young people to explore how the built world around them affects who they are and how they live. As young tecture walks and construct skyscrapers and sustainable cities, they apply academic concepts to real world situations. In addition, they gain a deeper understanding – and appreciation – of their own communities and the wider world.

Organizational background:  ArchForKids was established in 2013 by architect/educator Janny Gedeon and arts administrator Kathryn Slocum. It is a leading provider of STEAM (science/tech/engineering/art + design /math) programs in the New York metro area.  ArchForKids also provides a range of virtual programs to audiences across the country and world.

Why architecture? Architecture surrounds us - it is relevant, easily accessible and tangible. Math, science, social studies and art/design are all embedded in the built world.  Architecture is both an art and a highly technical field. Most kids like building things, feeling the accomplishment of problem-solving and creating something interesting, useful and beautiful. Architecture is a great medium for all kinds of learning and doing. 

Moreover, the built world can be used to support school curriculum and to make connections between schools, young people and the wider community. Involving children in design decisions about the places in which they live, learn and play can produce inspiring buildings that instill a sense of ownership and civic engagement. 

Our process: In ArchForKids offerings, young designers investigate, explore, measure, estimate, design, draw, calculate and construct. They go on neighborhood investigations, design parks and dream houses, propose uses for vacant lots, and much more. Our architect-educators teach core academic subjects through projects that deepen student understanding of the built world. Through this “hands-on, minds-on” approach to education, we encourage students to use design thinking and to become critical thinkers, creative makers and lifelong learners. 

ArchForKids programs are designed to:
• Use the local community as a living classroom
• Reach all styles of learners
• Use the design process to solve problems and challenges
• Sharpen STEAM content and knowledge
• Introduce children to the tools and strategies used by architects and engineers
• Extend/enrich school curricula and align with common core standards
• Improve ELA skills through journal writing/sharing and presentation of work 
• Nurture knowledge and appreciation for the aesthetics, history and function of communities
• Expose young people to potential careers related to the built environment

Our programs and partners: ArchForKids programs include in-school residencies, afterschool studios, library and museum workshops, all-day design challenges and more. We work with schools in New York City and Westchester County. In addition, ArchForKids has ongoing partnerships with the Brooklyn, Queens, New York and Westchester Public Libraries; City of Mount Vernon Youth Bureau and Tarrytown Summer Arts Camp. ArchForKids has served as artists/educators in residence for the Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian (NYC), the Hudson River Museum (Yonkers) and the High Line in Manhattan. ArchForKids works virtually with the nonprofit LEAD Coalition and the City of Panama City FL, leading charrettes in which teens re-imagine their community.

Through advanced cleaning, sanitization, and disinfection protocols, Paramount helps mitigate health risks, support public safety initiatives, and ensure operational continuity for the agencies and communities we serve.

Core Competencies

Healthcare and medical facility sanitation

Differentiators

Skilled, vetted, and detail-oriented workforce

rows.business_description:
Carter Lard Consulting (CLC) is a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) providing comprehensive consulting, staffing, and community development solutions across the public and private sectors. With over 30 years of combined experience, our multidisciplinary team delivers targeted, measurable, and sustainable outcomes that empower communities, enhance compliance, and strengthen institutional performance.

As a certified MBE and DBE, CLC specializes in a wide range of staffing solutions and related services designed to meet complex workforce and organizational needs. Our staffing division provides temporary and executive staffing, payrolling, background checks, PEO (Professional Employer Organization) services, workforce development, and specialized workforce training. We staff across multiple sectors including accounting, clerical, administration, architecture and engineering, construction, healthcare, human services, case management, information technology, legal, and finance. This breadth allows us to deliver adaptable and scalable solutions to diverse clients, from small community programs to large-scale government contracts.

CLC is also a trusted provider of emergency housing, disaster recovery, and supportive housing programs. We coordinate mobile outreach, shelter management, and relocation services while integrating case management, mental health support, and substance use recovery programs. Our Supportive Housing and Wraparound Services extend to affordable and low-income housing initiatives and are designed to align with tax incentive programs such as ICAP (MBE), LIHTC, SLIHC, J-51, and 420/421. Through these programs, we help housing developers, property managers, and government partners meet their compliance, case management, and social service delivery requirements efficiently and compassionately.

In addition, CLC offers occupational health services, including the operation and staffing of workplace and community-based clinics. We support both preventive and responsive healthcare initiatives to improve workforce health, safety, and overall productivity. Our team’s expertise in mental health, substance abuse, and addiction recovery ensures that our workforce and case management programs maintain a holistic, person-centered approach that addresses both immediate needs and long-term outcomes.

CLC’s compliance, risk, and administrative management services help clients navigate the complex regulatory environments governing MWBE programs, labor laws, and public-sector contracting. We provide comprehensive compliance oversight, risk assessment, auditing, and regulatory reporting, ensuring transparency and accountability at every level. Our work with agencies such as DSS, OTDA, and DOHMH reinforces our reputation as a trusted partner in maintaining ethical and operational standards.

Through our business consulting, cost reduction, and strategic development services, CLC supports organizations in achieving operational excellence and procurement readiness. We assist with certifications, proposal development, bid preparation, vendor registration (SAM.gov, PASSPort, DSBS, SFS), and logistics management. Our consultants also guide clients in supply chain optimization, expense management, and financial strategy, driving efficiency and sustainability across all business operations.

CLC’s commitment to training, education, and capacity building further empowers MWBEs, nonprofits, and community-based organizations. We design and deliver custom training programs focused on compliance, leadership, workforce development, and procurement readiness — equipping our partners with the tools to compete effectively in government and private contracting arenas.

At its core, Carter Lard Consulting’s mission extends beyond business. We collaborate with community organizations, social enterprises, and workforce initiatives to revitalize underserved neighborhoods through fair employment, economic inclusion, and equitable access to opportunity. By integrating staffing, housing, compliance, and social service expertise, CLC creates sustainable pathways for communities to thrive socially, environmentally, and economically.

rows.business_description:
Founded in 1977, Pelli Clarke & Partners has earned a reputation for designing buildings that express the core values of our clients. We have designed many of the world’s most recognizable buildings. Our award-winning portfolio includes master plans, academic buildings, libraries, museums, research centers and residences, and we have served public and private clients, businesses, institutions and government agencies. Great design arises from sincere collaboration with a client and a deep respect for a project’s environmental, economic and social contexts. 

Advancing Better Communities
Our firm’s broad portfolio demonstrates our dedication to the responsiveness to site, building character, materials, and technology. As design architects, we play the central role in interpreting the varied requirements of clients and user groups, as well as assimilating and interpreting the expertise of large teams of specialized consultants. Each constituency contributes to the process as we understand constraints, recognize and encourage innovation, and interpret requirements to solve complex architectural challenges in an urban setting. 

Sustainable Design
We have been a leader in environmentally sustainable design for over a decade. Our designs included sustainable strategies even before the U.S. Green Building Council established its Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) program. Our vision of sustainability extends beyond the technical concerns of reducing a building’s energy 
consumption. To be truly sustainable, a design must address the economic and cultural factors that make a project successful long into the future. 

Urban Design and Planning
Pelli Clarke & Partners has substantial experience in the design of successful large scale commercial projects. Working with government agencies and leading developers, we have been involved in the creation of major centers around the globe. Our design expertise has helped to shape four of the world’s largest private developments: Canary Wharf in London, the World Financial Center in New York, the International Finance Centre in Hong Kong and the Kuala Lumpur City Centre. Often incorporating complex transportation systems, memorable public spaces, and significant new buildings, these developments presented significant planning challenges. Our urban projects have resolved fundamental issues including land use, traffic, parking, and pedestrian circulation while establishing guidelines for architecture, historic preservation, landscape and streetscape. Our work is sensitive and responsive to budget and schedule constraints, historic master plans, and the programmatic requirements of each project. 

Design Excellence
Our firm has been honored with critical acclaim and hundreds of design awards, including the American Institute of Architects’ most prestigious recognition for an architectural practice, the Firm Award. In 1995, the American Institute of Architects awarded Cesar Pelli the Gold Medal, its highest honor for an individual. In 2004, the firm was awarded the Aga Khan Award for Architecture for the Petronas Towers.

Crowning Glory Beauty Parlour is a woman- and minority-owned luxury beauty suite located in the heart of Manhattan’s iconic Meatpacking District. Founded by a passionate and dedicated solo esthetician, Crowning Glory was born from a deeply personal journey of healing and self-restoration after the founder suffered second and third-degree burns to her face. Through that experience, she discovered a profound calling to help others feel confident and radiant in their own skin.

Crowning Glory specializes in personalized skincare and therapeutic body treatments that blend science, artistry, and wellness. Services include customized facials, chemical peels, lash extensions, full-body waxing, and massage therapy. Each service is designed to meet the unique needs of the client, focusing on results-driven care with a holistic touch. The founder brings both compassion and expertise to every treatment, fostering a nurturing environment that uplifts and empowers clients from all walks of life.

The name “Crowning Glory” reflects the business’s mission: to honor the inherent beauty and dignity of each individual. The studio offers a sanctuary where self-care becomes a sacred ritual — not just about appearance, but about healing, transformation, and self-love. Located near high-end retailers like Theory and YSL, the suite provides an exclusive, private space for clients to relax and recharge.

Crowning Glory also stands firmly on values of excellence, integrity, and inclusion. As a proud woman-owned, Latina-owned business, it strives to represent and serve diverse communities in an industry where representation and cultural competence are often lacking. The business actively supports women’s empowerment and mental well-being, and the founder’s background as a mother, entrepreneur, and nonprofit leader deeply informs the brand’s heart-centered approach.

Crowning Glory’s vision extends beyond beauty services. With plans to expand into product development, training workshops, and collaborative community events, the business seeks to make a lasting impact — inspiring others to walk boldly in their purpose and wear their “crowning glory” with pride.

rows.business_description:
For many business owners, finding the right technologies for their businesses and managing vendors’ day-to-day operations can be a cumbersome and overwhelming job. DYT Consulting (Design Your Technology) is here to make business owners’ lives simpler.

Technology can be overwhelming for ownership. DYT Consulting is here to make things simple.
We are an independent technology consulting firm primarily serving clients in the hospitality industry. We work with all types of hotels – brand name hotels, independent hotels, boutique hotels and health care– and we serve those outside the hospitality industry as well. Unlike other consultants, we take a hands-on approach in which we spend time on-site and manage the install from start to completion. We ensure that ownership/management groups are advised every step of the way on the progress of the job so that if any issues arise, they can be fixed promptly and the job can be completed within the expected timeframe. We also differ from most other consultants in that we have a background in installing technology and decades of experience in the hospitality/business industry.

We assist clients with budgeting and managing vendors for a wide range of technologies, including:
• Telephone Systems – such as PBX (private branch exchange)
• Wi-Fi (better guest experience)
• TV Services
• Carrier Services (voice/data circuits)
• Structured Cabling Systems (low voltage/fiber cabling and low voltage design, if needed)
• PMS (property management systems) / POS / Back of House Systems
• Security Cameras
• AV Systems
• Panic Buttons (housekeeping, back of house staff)
• Door Locks
• AV Services
• Signage and many more
    * We also assist clients with RFPs (requests for proposal)

Our services include:
• Helping clients cut costs on voice and data services
• Assisting clients in choosing or changing carrier services
• Overseeing the installation of large and small technology systems.
• Overseeing the replacement of technology that is out-of-date or is not functioning properly
• Make recommendations on the type of technology to use.

We've created a space where you can enjoy your salon experience. From the moment you enter our salon, we want you to feel right at home. 

With pride in our quality of service, we have carefully selected our team of passionate Nail Bae's that are committed to providing only the best quality service.

However, those dreams were halted due to circumstances beyond our control. In May of 2017, just days before our initial grand opening date, we were sidelined by a fire that began in the cellar, which quickly spread upward from the basement and into the salon. Fast forward to the present, after several years of patiently waiting, and finally receiving clearance from the City to occupy the space were were impacted once again, due to the corona-virus pandemic. 

As most restrictions have now been lifted. Vanity Beauty Bar Brooklyn is finally ready to reach new milestones and achievements, in conjunction with all safety and health guidelines implemented by the State of New York.

rows.business_description:
Uncle Yankey's Pepper Sauce isn't just delicious, It’s 
Pepperlicious! ….. PEPPA!

Uncle Yankey's Pepper Sauce was created in 2021 in the midst of the Covid pandemic and although it was very daunting at first, I went along with my dream of bringing a piece of my homeland from Trinidad and Tobago to the US to share with others.
I set out to recreate Uncle Yankey’s pepper sauce from my profound memories of home by staying true to my culture by incorporating fresh fruits, fresh seasonings with only the best peppers available while developing my own niche. 
Uncle Yankey’s started as a home based business in Brooklyn where it’s now being manufactured in Cook Collective Kitchen in Brooklyn, NY.
No other companies was offering hot sauce in quite this way where we took exotic tropical fruits like pineapple, passion fruit, papaya, mango along with healthy vegetables like beets and bell peppers, mixed in with fresh seasonings and raw peppers to create a flavorful and savory hot sauce with an intense heat that will leave your palate bursting with great robust flavors that could only be found in the Caribbean. 
When I sell Uncle Yankey’s pepper sauce to my customers I just don’t want to make a sale. I want them to enjoy the experience of seeing how colorful each blends looks, smell the fragrant aroma and taste each and flavorful ingredients it’s made with so they can develop a love for my pepper sauce just like I do and become a regular where my pepper sauce will become a staple item in their home. 
As of today Uncle Yankey’s has 12 great bold flavors for everyone’s palate, pineapple, grapefruit, strawberry, tropical, virgin tropical, scorpion mango, exotic grapes, healthy beets, avocado and banana pepper sauce, avocado and homemade pepper sauce.

rows.business_description:
Naz Little Angels Daycare, LLC of 255-19  147th Drive, Rosedale, NY, 11422, has 6 years of experience providing high-quality early childhood services responsive to the needs of families in Rosedale, Queens, NY.. We are located in Community District 29, an underserved area. During this period, we funded our services through a combination of ACS/HRA vouchers and private pay. The poverty rate in the 11422 shows a need for high-quality, low-cost childcare. We currently can serve children from infancy to five years of age as per our licenses with the NYCDOHMH.
Gemma Andrews-Cole, the Executive Director, is responsible for recruiting, hiring & training the best employees with B.A.s & M.A.s in ECE fields as Lead Teachers. We employ two staff members for our current group family daycare and will hire one Lead Teacher/Educational director, and one teacher assistant for the proposed 3-K program. We anticipate that the culture of the organizational environment will change and influence our operations as we begin the new 3-K initiative. We will serve twelve 3-K or 3-year-olds at our location.
We determined the need for no cost and accessible child care by conducting a local needs assessment & a review of area demographic data that confirmed a growing demand for childcare services for children aged three. The demand grew because of the increasing number of immigrant families moving to the community & the rising birth rate. We serve parents & children in Rosedale, county of Queens., NYS, working primarily with young people who are African American and Latino & immigrant families who often exist within disadvantaged economic, social, & family circumstances. 
We dedicate our programs to ensuring that our community’s immigrant youth have greater access to quality programs & services that will enhance their lives & shape their futures. Our staff members speak Spanish, English and French Creole to benefit parents and children in the program. The population served includes African American, Latino and Asian children. At least 30% of the prekindergarten families served are from low-income families. 
We are unique because of our solid reputation & excellent service over sixEn years; we have higher scores in ECERS-R than public schools. We speak diverse languages displayed at international & special holiday entertainment shows with families. Our environment is warm & comforting in child-friendly facilities. Our enthusiastic, well-trained & credentialed teachers implement NYS PKFCC & DOE EFQ & Framework for Great Schools to advance program quality. Credentialed teachers use ongoing, observation-based assessments, approved curricula, Key Developmental Indicators & NYS Early Learning Guidelines. We empower families’ self-sufficiency. We recognize parents, foster parents, & other primary caregivers as children’s first and most influential teachers and help them extend learning at home.

rows.business_description:
Welcome to Urban Vegan Roots: A Culinary and Cultural Haven in Astoria, Queens

Urban Vegan Roots (UVR) is a pioneering 100% plant-based restaurant located on 31st Street in Astoria, Queens, designed to redefine the vegan dining experience. Brought to you by the visionary team behind Urban Vegan Kitchen, UVR stands as a vibrant cultural hub where food, art, and community converge. Our mission is to celebrate the richness of vegan cuisine while fostering an inclusive environment that welcomes everyone, regardless of dietary preferences.

At UVR, we pride ourselves on our innovative menu, featuring a delightful array of savory seitan dishes and veggie-forward creations. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted to tantalize your taste buds and dispel the myth that vegan food is bland or unsatisfying. Whether you’re a lifelong vegan or a curious newcomer, our offerings promise a culinary experience that leaves you feeling fulfilled and inspired.

More Than Just a Restaurant

UVR transcends the typical dining experience. We are a sanctuary for creativity and collaboration, inviting entrepreneurs, artists, and musicians to connect and thrive. Our space is designed to accommodate everything from intimate date nights to lively birthday parties and business gatherings. With daily happy hour specials from 12 PM to 7 PM, an extensive mocktail menu, and decadent desserts, UVR is the perfect spot for any occasion.

On weekends, join us for our brunch featuring classic tunes that help to create an atmosphere that captures the essence of New York City. Our goal is to provide a safe and welcoming environment where all guests can enjoy plant-based cuisine without judgment, while also gaining insight into the often-misunderstood culture of veganism.

Our Mission and Vision

At UVR, our mission goes beyond serving delicious food; we strive to empower our team and community. We believe in nurturing creativity, encouraging personal growth, and maximizing earning potential. Our culture is built on collaboration and compassion, and we aspire to make a positive impact on as many lives as possible through our culinary and cultural initiatives. Our years-long partnerships with Hip hop is Green, Support & Feed, The Astoria Food Pantry, and The Queensbridge Initiative speak to our commitment to foster relationships within the community to help spread the message of healthy living as well as feed those in need. As we grow, so will our reach to outlying communities who might have access to healthy food or information on the plant-based lifestyle.

Our core values guide us in everything we do:

- Inclusivity: We celebrate NYC culture and foster an environment where everyone feels welcome.
- Knowledge Sharing: Embracing the philosophy of "Each One, Teach One," we believe in the transformative power of sharing experiences and insights.
- Hard Work & Play: We are dedicated and driven, yet we also value joy and fun in our endeavors.
- Community: We are a family, committed to supporting one another and creating a sense of belonging.
- Creativity: We honor diverse artistic expressions and encourage innovative thinking.
- Compassion: We aim to spread love and joy through our culinary offerings and cultural contributions.

Join Us

We invite you to explore a unique dining experience where food meets culture, and every meal is an opportunity for connection. As a proud MWBE-certified business, we are dedicated to supporting and uplifting our community while showcasing the richness of vegan cuisine. We welcome you to come, savor our dishes, and be part of our vibrant family. Discover the flavors of compassion and creativity at Urban Vegan Roots—where everyone is welcome, and every meal tells a story.

rows.business_description:
We partner with school systems to design solutions to evolve their teaching and learning operating framework into 21st-century STEM Education framework through transformative professional development, game-changing AI technology, and curiosity-based student focused experiences, all aligning to standards. We support our partners in providing ALL students access to a comprehensive STEM Education early, often, and everywhere. 

Our framework provides a structured and strategic pathway to prepare students not just to survive but to thrive in the rest of the 21st Century. At the heart of this framework is a Comprehensive STEM Education System (CSTEMES™) approach. This is not just a process, it’s a collaborative journey, starting with aligning or developing a STEM Integration Strategy using a five-step process to ensure unity throughout the school system. 

After learning where a school system falls within the Four Levels of STEM™ on the STEM Integration Continuum™, we work collaboratively to set the context, provide all students access to STEM experiences, upskill educators through our Design Thinking-infused Pedagogy (DTIP™) with Pdgogy.ai™, and finally, involve the community through our Collective Impact STEM Integrated Community (CISTEMIC™) model. 

Our digital platform, Pdgogy.ai, customizes curriculum through a student-focused pedagogy, helping students discover what they love, what they are good at, what the world needs, and what they can be paid for. 

Ultimately, we provide thought leadership, consulting, and dynamic solutions to educators and educational stakeholders to help school systems prepare students for work, entrepreneurship, service, and college by providing a Comprehensive STEM™ education so students can thrive in a world shaped by AI, robotics, and automation.

rows.business_description:
Award-winning content creators Samson Styles and Tyese Carmichael-Styles have joined forces to create JayCity Enterprise, a multi-faceted media company specializing in TV/Film Production, Marketing, Branding, Development and Consultation services. Founded in 2017, the company is an umbrella for all creative endeavors, collaborations, contributions and education. 

JayCity Enterprise has three separate programs it teaches to scholars ranging from grades 4- infinity. First, is our Scripted Content Development Program that teaches students how to turn their real- life experiences into a script and then transform that script into a short film. Active participation from students teaches them how to perform in front of the camera as actors, as well as behind the scenes producers. Second, is our Documentary program that serves scholars from grades 8 - infinity. The program's objective: Give students the general introduction to the art of storytelling by way of documentaries and visual arts. Third is our Anti- Gun Violence workshop that we created based off of our award winning documentary KILLING BEEF 'Gun VIolence in the Black Community' for our scholars from grades 8 - infinity. The Student will identify with the general effects of gun violence in underserved communities. The Student will identify with people personal encounters of gun violence and its personal effects. And the mindset that causes gun violence to permeate in underserve communities. The Trainee will identify with the history and conditions that exist in underserve communities that encourages gun violence and will become better equip in critical thinking to help reduce gun violence. All of our programs help scholars to enrich personal language, background knowledge, and vocabulary through reading and communicating with others.
 
With well over three decades of individual media experience under their belts, Samson and Tyese have produced more than 100 hours of television for some of the most reputable networks including NBC, PBS, BET, FOX, Netflix and more. While Samson has most reputably served as a journalist, correspondent and producer, Tyese has been behind the scenes getting the deals done. From acquisitions to branding, casting to directing, both Samson and Tyese execute at the highest level. But it wasn’t until they started working on their independent documentary Killing Beef that they realized their power, not just as a married couple but as a force in Entertainment. Killing Beef hit the film festival circuit in 2018 and won Best Documentary at the Academy Accredited Newark International Film Festival, and in just three short months was picked up by Revolt TV. Since the network premiere of Killing Beef, Rutgers University Center for Gun Violence Research has incorporated the documentary into their program curriculum.  
 
The success and reach of Killing Beef has truly put JayCity Enterprise on the map, not only a media conglomerate but as the destination for content actualization. Now, Samson and Tyese are even more passionate about not only building their slate but seeing projects through to distribution. Currently, they are focused on unscripted and scripted content dedicated to cultural commentary. 
 
Their mission of authentic, passionate storytelling is evident in all that they do, and they are focused on providing entertainment with heart and integrity that will impact audiences around the world!

Elevate Theatre Company LLC is theater for health. We have a mission to create space for audiences and artists to explore health and well-being through the art of storytelling. Elevate is the only theater company in New York City providing free programming with an explicit vision of improving health and well-being through storytelling. We partner with established health and wellness organizations, professional playwrights and artists, and expert panelists to support audience engagement and action planing post-performance. We also host storytelling workshops for participants of all ages, leveraging theater-based activities to engage participants in sharing their authentic stories, promoting healthy habits, and improving communication. 

Elevate was founded on the belief that storytelling is a powerful, healing community activity. We believe that access to health and the arts is a human right. We believe in boundless artistic expression. We believe in accessible, reliable, and accurate health information provided by experts. We believe in promoting underrepresented narratives. 

Our founder and executive director, Christina D. Eskridge, MPH has over a decade of experience in both healthcare and the performing arts sectors. Christina has a Master’s Degree in Public Health from UC Berkeley, and has worked as a healthcare consultant in safety net facilities, on large scale public health projects, and at one of the largest health systems in the country, Kaiser Permanente. Additionally, Christina is a performing artist, playwright, director and teaching artist, working for small and large theater organizations around the country and serving a variety of audiences.

rows.business_description:
Renee’s Way Inc. provides educational services regarding literacy, social emotional learning, cultural diversity instruction and leadership training. Dr. Nay’s Professional Development Workshops are theoretically designed so that participants experience a self-discovery learning process grounded in research-based literacy principles. Based upon the interactive nature of the workshops, sessions ensure that all participants have an optimally meaningful experience. Each session is conducted with intense instructional focus and active engagement. According to institutional needs, individualized programs and packages are designed and priced upon request.

Available services are two-pronged, designed for educators and 5th -12th grade students.
         
• At the student level, interactive workshops and motivational speaking performances are available for schools and youth organizations. As a seasoned educator, Dr. Nay believes that it is essential to empower children at a young age. She published children’s literature, Sistah Girl: Step into Your Greatness (Amazon Best-Seller), and Yo Bro: Strive Toward Excellence to fill the void of quality diverse literature in today’s classrooms. Poem titles like, Sistah Hair, Flavors of People, and Black Lives Matter are meaningful topics to adolescents, especially of color populations. The books were written to help guide young adults through adolescence toward excellence by identifying their aspirations, teaching them their responsibilities as role models, and showing them how they can make a difference in the world as agents of change, while reinforcing social emotional learning and literacy skills. Workshop topics include cultural acceptance, bullying, youth activism, and self-esteem. Sessions are hands-on with the use of manipulatives like beach balls and bingo cards to keep the students cognitively engaged and motivated and accommodate learning styles and special needs. Handouts and/or published books are available for purchase. 

• Professional development, concerning pedagogical and feminine leadership training opportunities, are offered to teachers and school support staff. Critical conversation, bias evaluation, and culturally relevant teaching are some of the available topics of study. Workshop titles include “Get Set, Ready: Reflect, Rethink, Respond…. Go!” and “Enriching Conversations with Our Rich Stories.” Dr. Nay’s book publication, “Embrace Your Power: A Sistah-to-Sistah Conversation” serves as an instructional tool that affords her readers an opportunity to self-reflect and self-empower as teachers and leaders through her poetic craft.

The founder and president of Renee’s Way Inc., Dr. Renee White aka Dr. Nay, is a former NYC DOE classroom teacher and reading specialist. She is permanently certified as a N-6 teacher, Reading Specialist, and School District Administrator. Currently, as a 25+ year college professor of teacher education, Dr. White publishes motivational poetry and instructional materials that promote acceptance, and youth and women empowerment.

rows.business_description:
Mainstreet Broadcasting, LLC provides economic empowerment programming that focuses on those on Main Street America who benefit from virtual learning via videos, social media platforms, company websites, etc.

As CEO of Mainstreet, Ryan C. Mack has for many years seen the void that existed in urban and many rural communities when it comes to money management issues. Many are not only unbanked or under-banked but lack knowledge of simple concepts such as interest rates, credit scores, mortgage applications, etc. Without this knowledge we have an entire segment of our collective communities who will always have difficulty being productive citizens and productive workers in the job market.

In today’s job market with today’s technology, the best way to reach this population is with virtual learning. Mainstreet provides this virtual learning thereby giving many the knowledge needed to add stability to their lives. Mainstreet’s virtual financial education program provides the basic foundation needed to know the best strategies to budget, save and spend – no matter how much money you make.

Mainstreet’s Mission

Main Street Broadcasting, LLC (“Main Street”) has a mission to create and implement tangible economic empowerment programs using virtual/digital broadcasting as a vehicle for the education of individuals in underserved communities. As a change agent in these communities Main Street develops and administers programs that focus on teaching and increasing exposure to sound principles of money management. Working individually and also in collaboration with other community partners, Main Street believes that individuals, businesses, schools and communities can be educated to understand and adhere to those financial principles which will serve as a solid foundation for their own future economic growth and sustainability.

rows.business_description:
Founded in 2009, the Phoblographer is a story of a few driven individuals working to change the way we think about cameras. It started with taking the cameras and lenses out of the lab and into the field. We’re all passionate photographers. And we love to shoot our daily lives with the photo gear we purchase. So it just makes sense for us to incorporate it into our lives. That’s what our staff does.

The website has bridged the gap between the art world and the tech world for over a decade. We do this holistically in all our content as much as possible. It starts with our reviews. By applying it in our gear tests, we work to remind photographers that there’s still a passionate, creative person behind the camera. So you have to work to get the shot. This is further translated through in our various interviews and series’ like Creating the Photograph. What’s more, we’ve worked with partners over the years to uplift the voices of women, POCs, disabled photographers, and others. Our Editor in Chief and Founder Chris Gampat is legally blind. And through Phoblographer, we’ve worked to motivate and inspire passionate photographers everywhere. Nothing should hold you back from getting the shot!
Our founder has been involved in every aspect of the company’s growth and development over the years. He cares, and it shows holistically through the content. Part of the site’s strength is our incredibly strong Search Engine Optimization. We’ve applied strict ethics to our stories and earn the trust of Google and our readers. Everything from our word choices, stories we tackle, and our image selection is meticulously chosen.
More can be found in our media kit: https://www.thephoblographer.com/media-kit-the-phoblographer/

rows.business_description:
Bamboo Walk is a multifaceted Black owned restaurant, boasting fine dining, intimate cabana dining, a robust take out menu, and the first ever drive-thru Caribbean restaurant in all of north eastern America. Developed from divine inspiration, Bamboo Walk is owned and operated by Paula Mercure, a Jamaican-born immigrant turned Baldwin resident.

Bamboo Walk is often described as a Caribbean restaurant with excellent food, great drinks and a brilliantly designed ambiance. Some may also describe it as a diamond in the rough, but all agree that Bamboo Walk is top-tier when it comes to customer service. What makes it most unique is the cuisine - the blending of two cultures people never thought could come together - a Jamaican and Haitian combination that both intrigues and delights all who visit.

Today we celebrate not only what Bamboo Walk sells but what it represents. For so long, and even today, women have experienced inequality in economic opportunities, educational inequities, and so much more. Bamboo Walk became a reality because a group of Black immigrants and college educated professionals came together with their resources and decided to build.

BaRupOn is a leading medical products distributor that aims to offer a wide selection of high-quality products at an exceptional value. We have been partnering with the medical professionals and medical service providers in servicing the medical industry for the last 5 years. Our goal is to become a leader in the marketplace, capitalizing on our continuous growth, in providing many product choices with high quality and great value under one roof; servicing multiple market segments.

rows.business_description:
AVOR Educators, LLC is a New York City–based learning design and communications studio founded in 2018. AVOR helps mission-driven organizations articulate what they do best — designing the professional learning, curriculum, and communications that allow schools, cultural institutions, nonprofits, and public agencies to deliver their full impact to the communities they serve. AVOR serves clients across the five boroughs and the greater New York metropolitan area, with capacity for remote and national engagements.

LEARNING DESIGN & PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT. AVOR designs and delivers professional development and training programs for educators, school leaders, and organizational teams. Services include design and facilitation of professional learning community (PLC) systems and inquiry cycles; teacher and teacher-leader development series; leadership training and coaching structures; instructional training in literacy, Universal Design for Learning (UDL), culturally responsive pedagogy, and inclusive practices for students with disabilities; and complete arcs of learning developed in partnership with school and program leaders — from needs assessment and vision-setting through session design, facilitation, progress tracking, and evaluation support.

CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT. AVOR develops custom, standards-aligned curriculum for K–12 schools, cultural institutions, community-based organizations, and enrichment programs. Capabilities include unit and course design; performance-based assessment development; project-based and service-learning programming; culturally responsive and heritage-based curriculum; and program design connecting institutional collections, archives, and community history to classroom and public learning.

STRATEGIC COMMUNICATIONS & STORYTELLING. AVOR provides communications services for mission-driven organizations and leaders, including communications strategy; press releases and media relations; campaign development; event publicity and on-site media coverage; social media content development; talking points and interview preparation; and funder-facing impact reporting that documents program outcomes for grant reporting, renewals, and sponsor development.

EXPERIENTIAL & TRAVEL-BASED LEARNING. In partnership with host organizations, AVOR designs and co-facilitates immersive learning journeys for students and community groups — trip curriculum, itinerary design as an arc of learning, and on-site facilitation. Past programs include student learning journeys to Savannah, GA and Baltimore, MD in partnership with New York youth-development organizations.
WHO WE SERVE. K–12 schools, districts, and charter networks; cultural institutions, archives, and museums; nonprofit and community-based organizations; foundations and public agencies; and mission-driven founders, creatives, and small businesses. Engagements are available as multi-month retainers, fixed-fee project contracts, single trainings and workshops, and event-based engagements.

LEADERSHIP & QUALIFICATIONS. AVOR is led by Founder & CEO Shavonn Doughlin, M.S.Ed, a former Chief Academic Officer of a six-school New York City charter network serving approximately 1,600 students. Ms. Doughlin holds New York State School District Leader (SDL) and School Building Leader (SBL) certifications and NYS teaching certifications in Students with Disabilities (7–12), Generalist (5–9), and English Language Arts (7–12). Her experience spans classroom instruction, school leadership, network-level academic strategy, curriculum development at citywide scale, and organizational development. She is a contributing curriculum developer to a PK–12 Black Studies curriculum published for New York City Public Schools in collaboration with the Black Education Research Collective at Teachers College, Columbia University, and a published contributor on education and equity. She has served as a featured speaker at national and international education conferences.

PAST PERFORMANCE. AVOR has delivered multi-month professional development and capacity-building contracts for New York City charter school networks, including an eight-month engagement spanning literacy instruction, co-teaching practice, special education support, and teacher-leader development. Additional engagements include curriculum design and implementation for regional education firms, communications and publicity campaigns for cultural organizations and artists, and experiential learning programs with youth-development foundations.

CORE CAPABILITIES: professional development, training and facilitation, curriculum development, instructional design, professional learning communities, leadership development, education consulting, strategic communications, media relations, content development, impact reporting, experiential learning, educational travel programs.
AVOR designs learning and tells stories so that people doing good work are seen, heard, and funded.
